description: A stereo stream cut onto a grid, with one slice in every so many replaced by an altered copy of itself, and the rest passing through untouched

params.text: Picks what happens to an altered slice: silence, a swap of the two sides, an earlier slice fetched back, the one before played backwards or slowed, a stutter, or all seven in turn
Sets how often the effect fires, from every slice to one in sixteen; it is the last slice of each group that fires, so the effect lands on the approach to the beat rather than on it
Sets how long each slice is, 10ms to 1 second, and it does nothing while a cable is in the clock jack
Crossfades the altered slice against the untouched one, silence to full
Sets how far back DELAY and SHUFFLE may fetch from, 1 to 32, counted in slices or, once a cable is in the bar jack, in bars
Sets the slice length against the clock interval: divided by 8, 4 or 2, equal to it at the centre, or multiplied by 2, 4 or 8
Picks the fade curve: Gaussian, which is the narrowest, Hann, or Log, which is the widest
Stops the write head and loops what is already in the buffer
Rolls a fresh set of choices on each press: which earlier slice SHUFFLE fetches, how far back DELAY reaches, which way PITCH goes, and where MIXED starts
Sets how much of each slice is fade, from a 5ms edge taper at one end of the travel to half the slice at the other, where the two fades meet and the slice becomes a grain envelope

inputs.text: The left side of the signal being cut up
The right side of the signal being cut up; with nothing patched it carries the left side
Sets the slice length from the time between rises, times the clock rate switch, in place of the length knob
Changes REACH from counting slices to counting bars, so DELAY and SHUFFLE fetch from musically useful distances
A rise returns the slice grid and the pattern to their start
A high gate stops the write head and loops the buffer, which is what the freeze switch does by hand
A rise rolls a fresh set of choices for SHUFFLE, DELAY, PITCH and MIXED
Picks the effect, one volt per effect, added to the effect switch
Changes how often the effect fires, one volt per step, added to the ratio switch
Changes the crossfade, ±5V added to the depth knob
Changes the slice length, ±5V added to the length knob
Changes how far back the fetching effects reach, a tenth of a volt per slice or per bar, added to the reach knob

outputs.text: The left side of the reworked stream
The right side of the reworked stream
A trigger at every slice boundary
A gate held high for as long as a slice is being altered

notes: an untouched slice passes through sample for sample with no delay, which is why REVERSE and PITCH work on the slice before; REPEAT stays on the arriving one
every random choice comes from the slice number and one seed, so a pattern repeats exactly; RESEED changes the seed and gives a different pattern, equally fixed
the channel pairing parameter is declared without a panel switch, so the two sides always make the same choices and cannot be set to choose independently
menu: Buffer length — sets how many seconds of audio are held, and shows how much memory that takes
